LOGO COMPANY.SOP: New Employee Onboarding Standard Operating Procedure

PROCESS OVERVIEW.Process Description: This procedure defines the standardized process for onboarding new employees, covering pre-start activities, first-day orientation, system and facility provisioning, training assignments, and milestone reviews through confirmation of employment.
PROCESS OVERVIEW.Purpose & Scope: Purpose: Ensure a consistent, compliant, and positive onboarding experience for all new hires. Scope: Applies to all full-time, part-time, and contract hires across all Acme Tech Solutions locations. Covers HR, IT, Facilities, Payroll, Hiring Managers, and Training teams.
PROCESS OVERVIEW.Definitions & Related Documents: Definitions: 'New Hire' - individual with accepted employment offer; 'HRIS' - Human Resources Information System; 'Onboarding Checklist' - standardized list of tasks to complete for each new hire. Related Documents: Offer Letter Template, Employee Handbook, Background Check Policy, I-9 and Tax Forms, HRIS User Guide, IT Account Provisioning Guide, Facilities Access Request Form.

PROCESS STEPS.Task: Receive signed offer and confirm start date
Create employee record in HRIS and assign employee ID
Send welcome email with new hire packet, required forms, and first-day agenda
Prepare and provide employment agreement and required new hire paperwork (I-9, W-4, direct deposit)
Initiate background check, education and employment verification
Set up payroll profile and enroll employee in benefits per eligibility
Request IT account creation (email, network access, collaboration tools)
Allocate hardware and software licenses, image devices, and prepare peripherals
Prepare workspace, badge/access card, parking and security access
Schedule orientation sessions and assign orientation materials
Conduct first-day orientation (company overview, policies, benefits overview)
Hiring manager meets with new hire to review role, expectations and team introductions
Assign job-specific training plan and required learning modules
Complete mandatory compliance, security and data privacy training
Set up initial performance goals and 30/60/90 day milestones
Conduct 30-day check-in to review progress, address issues and update training plan
Conduct 60-day development review and adjust goals or support as needed
Conduct 90-day probationary review and confirm employment status or recommend actions
